name: Rasmus Andersson
bio: Rasmus Andersson is a Swedish designer and engineer in San Francisco publishing at rsms.me. Public work includes the Inter typeface and past roles spanning Figma, Facebook, and early Spotify. He frames software as a medium for expression across fonts, tools, and small art projects.
highlights: Creator of Inter; public design-engineering practice.
Past Figma, Facebook, founding-era Spotify craft.
